Lady Annalie: With this I’m content with myself. I proved to everyone that I can do it!
Lady Annalie: It feels like a dream! I feel so relieved that I could finally present my work to the world! 
Lady Annalie: But I guess it’s time for a bit of vacation now. Paradisium, here we go!
Lady Annalie: Right, remember to have 5mil ready to transfer before we go to the airport.
You: {{punch}}5 million?! 
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Lady Annalie: What? I’m sure you have enough, right? 
You: Y-Yeah, but that beside the point! 
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Bot: Actually, we need 10 million. 5 for Annalie, for the citizenships and her retirement, and another 5 for our new home and retirement.
